notes: This directory is the authoritative stable Linx ISA 0.58 profile aligned to PTO ISA 0.58.5.
PTO-ISA/pto-spec is the sole normative source for 466 scalar forms, 76 command forms, and 108 tile operations; pto-spec.lock.json freezes its exact commit and tree.
Linx retains its additive two-level extensions; PTO publishes 46 extension reservations covering their complete encoding space and the nonzero Fixup displacement spaces.
TEPL uses separate Mode and Function fields as the unchanged encoding carrier for VEC and SFU; the legacy TileOpcode and all legacy decode aliases are forbidden.
BSTART.TEPL is the unique compiled carrier identity; BSTART.VEC and BSTART.SFU are accepted assembly aliases with engine-specific canonical output.
The exact tile inventory is 31 VEC, 55 SFU, 10 TLSU, and 12 CUBE operations. Unlisted selectors and unassigned functions trap as illegal instructions.

The exact semantic classes are 25 elementwise-tile-tile, 15 tile-scalar-and-immediate, 28 reduce-and-expand, 9 memory-and-data-movement, 12 matrix-and-matrix-vector, 10 layout-and-rearrangement, and 9 irregular-and-complex operations.
S0 through S63 are absolute-index shared tile registers in a core-private bank shared by the core's four PEs.
B.IOS names shared-register sources and destinations and carries the PE mask; B.IOT is Local-only, and mask zero is a NOP.
Deleted scalar and block spellings are assembler errors and do not retain v0.58 encoding reservations.
TLSU is the tile load/store encoding family; generic BSTART.TLSU is not a legal textual instruction, and each assigned function has an exact named form.
